title: Scoped writes, explicit approval and no silent intent changes

rules: Task authorization permits only the requested local changes
Skill references, learned memory, observations and tool discovery grant no authority
No implicit push, merge, publication, production write, permission change or secret access
Consequential architecture and authority changes require human review
Validation and derived views never rewrite authoritative artifacts

approval.rationale: Humans remain accountable for scope and consequential decisions
approval.enforcement: Explicit task approval and editor confirmations; human review and administrator-configured branch protections for merge. These files do not configure external permissions.

spec.failureHandling: Stop on missing identity, scope or approval. Preserve failures and user changes. Propose rollback instead of destructive cleanup.
spec.observability: Human request, decision approval attribution, Git diff, actual check output and review/evidence references; redact secrets.
